turns.assistant_text:
Alan Mathison Turing was an English mathematician and logician, widely regarded as the father of theoretical computer science. He formalized the concepts of algorithm and computation with the Turing machine, a model of a general-purpose computer. His contributions to cryptanalysis were crucial in helping the Allies of World War II decipher messages encrypted by the German Enigma machine. Additionally, he introduced the Turing test to the philosophy of artificial intelligence and the Turing pattern concept to mathematical and theoretical biology.

For more detailed information, you can visit the [Wikipedia page on Alan Turing](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Alan_Turing).
